sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 610. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Anguish Collapse (Ability Power decreases by 50 when attacking an enemy not in Break, applies Grief with a 10% to chance to increase damage received by 50%, disables Unison gauge filling effects) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Light and Time Defense from Unison Damage +500
